summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing daily buyback notices provided to the Australian Securities Exchange under its $1 billion share repurchase program. The program covers Class A and Class B common stock, repurchased from time to time. The filing is routine disclosure in connection with ongoing capital returns, not a new special situation. It includes forward-looking statements about repurchase intentions. No specific terms such as price or number of shares are stated. What to watch: pace of repurchases and impact on share count and EPS.
